Title: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query

User impact: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query.

More info: The issue is specifically happening when using "$Select" as part of the query.

Affected users can bypass the issue by not using "$Select" in the queries. 

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query

User impact: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query.

More info: The issue is specifically happening when using "$Select" as part of the query.

Affected users can bypass the issue by not using "$Select" in the queries. 

Current status: We identified a code regression after a recent service update to Microsoft Defender for Office 365 that is impacting OData $Select queries. We've developed a code fix for the issue and are deploying to the affected environment to remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any user querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query. 

Start time: Thursday, August 13, 2026, at 6:41 PM UTC

Root cause: A code regression after a recent services update is impacting OData $Select query, causing failures.

Next update by: Saturday, August 22, 2026, at 5:30 AM UTC
